title: A society of castas
goal: I can explain how people were classified in colonial cities and what casta paintings showed.
grammar: Impersonal se: how a society classified people

items: I can explain how people were classified in colonial cities.
I can name some casta terms and say what they were used for.
I can describe what casta paintings showed.
I can say why historians think daily life was more flexible than the paintings.
I can use impersonal se to say what was done to people without saying who did it.
